name: wishluck-order-ops-agent
description: AI order-ops & customer support agent for an Indian D2C store (COD confirmation, NDR follow-up, returns, handover).

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix cli install && npm --prefix cli run build && cp -n .env.example backend/.env || true
scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && cd backend && FRONTEND_URL=http://localhost:4000 npx tsx src/index.ts
